chapter: Ory, Mutt and New Orleans life
title: How old Ory and Mutt Carey are
summary: They discuss the argument over Ory's age; Hall puts him around 73 and Mutt a year or two younger.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I was going to ask a little bit about Mutt, since Mutt, Kerry, isn't here anymore. He did a talk for himself. In the first place, I was wondering about how old Mutt was. Do you think he was as old as Ory? Ory thought he was about the same age, maybe.

Well, I don't know. From my cousin, she told me Mutt is not as old as Ory. Wasn't as old. No, they may be about a year, two years different than the age. But he said he wasn't, but there's a big argument going on now about how old Ory is.

The paper said 71. No, he's older than that, because the reason I know he's older than that, we had a blowout for him in San Francisco. That's been about two years, three years since he was up there. And he made 71 then. So I think Ory is right there. He's around about 73 years old.
He was a right age, see.

He's about 73 years old. And Mutt was, I'd say about two years, wasn't much a year or two between. I'd always thought he was younger, too. No, no, no, because my cousin knows more, see, because she's about 65 now. She knows more, you know. And she said, no, Ory is, he's been sticking on that 71 for the last two, three years. Ory is about 73 years old.
